GenerateGroupImage.description_en: Generates image groups for a single item with multiple images or for multiple items
GenerateGroupImage.description_zh: 组图接口，用于单item多图和多item生成组图

ImportProducts.description_en: Creates product information for a business. After a successful import, the platform returns a globally unique platform_item_id for subsequent updates and association with recognition results. If the item_unique_id is duplicated within the same business, the platform returns conflict information
ImportProducts.description_zh:
● 用于业务方新增商品信息。
● 导入成功后，平台返回全局唯一的 platform_item_id，供后续更新和识别结果关联使用。
● 同一业务方下，item_unique_id 重复时，平台应返回冲突信息

QueryRecognitionResult.description_en:
At least one result retrieval method must be configured: webhook callback or task status polling. Both methods can be configured simultaneously.
•If you choose the webhook callback method, prepare a receiving endpoint in advance and implement it according to the following request parameters and response elements.
•After a recognition task is completed, the platform pushes the result to the business endpoint based on the callback URL bound to the task
QueryRecognitionResult.description_zh:
需要至少需要接入一种结果获取方式：webhook 回调或任务状态查询；两种方式可同时接入。
•若用户选择 webhook 回调方式，需要提前准备好接收接口，并按以下入参和出参实现。
•当识别任务结束后，平台将根据任务绑定的回调地址向业务方推送结果

RecognizeOrder.description_en: Creates an asynchronous recognition task for intelligent recognition scenarios by using the OSS URL of a shopping video, returns a task ID, and sends notifications through a webhook. You must call a query operation to obtain the results
RecognizeOrder.description_zh: 用于智能识别场景， 需要上传购物视频 OSS 地址，平台创建异步识别任务并立即返回task_id, 通过webhook 通知，需要主动查询接口获取结果

RegisterWebhook.description_en: Registers or updates the default webhook callback URL
RegisterWebhook.description_zh: 用于注册&更新默认webhook 回调地址

UpdateProduct.description_en: Updates the information of an existing item on the platform
UpdateProduct.description_zh: 用于更新平台内已存在的商品信息
